title: Dallinde laamu timmungu
intro: E jamaanu ɓooyɗo, neɗɗo baawɗo ummii ngam laamaade leydi mawndi e hoɗɓe mum. Laamu nguuɗoo limoore ina maantiniri mawnikinaare mawnde e caɗeele luggiɗe e laamu diine. Heɓde ngam udditde sifaa ruuhu mo baasal mum timmungal wonti jannde duumiinde wonande yontaaji kala.
clues: Miɗo joginoo laamu mawngu, ɗo konngol am woni sariya.
Mi hollitii hoore am ko mi laamɗo ɓurɗo toowde, miɗo ɗaɓɓa dewal e denndaangal les njiimaandi am.
Mi tooñii renndo keeriiɗo, mi maccuni ɗum en, mi yamiri warngooji maɓɓe worɓe cukalel.
Miɗo fotnoo hawrude e nulaaɗo Alla lesɗikiniiɗo, baɗɗo kaawisaaji laaɓtuɗi e yeeso am e maagiyaŋkooɓe am.
Mi salii goonga e tiiɗnaare, mi tuumi nulaaɗo oo ko majjere, miɗo felliti halkude mo e almuɓɓe makko.
Min e konu am fof, min 6uuccii maayo, min 6uuccii 6e min 6uuccii e juucfe am.
arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verse: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them, (20:78)
